title: Existence rule body
description: sprk_policyversion.sprk_rulebody shape for sprk_ruletype = Existence (spec FR-05; design.md section 8.0.1(a) / CM-7). An 'all' array of independent EXISTS / NOT EXISTS clauses over a fixed window, each expressible as a single Dataverse FetchXML link-entity filter (design.md CM-3). Cross-clause variable binding is REFUSED at this schema level, not merely by review: clauses additionalProperties=false forbids a 'bind' property outright, and every filter value is pattern-restricted to reject a leading '$' variable-dereference token (e.g. '$commitment.sprk_receiveddate').

subject.description: The subject entity's logical name this rule evaluates against (e.g. sprk_matter).

when.description: Optional scope filter over the subject. Empty object = all subjects. Shares the clause filters' per-value grammar (#/$defs/filterConditions): the same scalar/array/operator shapes, the same leading-'$' refusal and the same numeric evaluation, so a 'when' value cannot carry what a clause value may not.

all.description: Every clause must hold (AND). No cross-clause references between elements.

then.description: RESERVED, and refused (task 022 rework round 3, L2): no task defines 'then' and no code reads it. Early drafts put signalType/severity/messageTemplate/proposedAction here; those now live in their own sprk_policyversion columns (the sentence template's single source is sprk_messagetemplate, the only template checked against the predicate's read set, section 0.3). Listed here only so the refusal is explicit rather than an anonymous additionalProperties failure; RuleBodySchemaValidator reports it with its own message before schema evaluation.

clause.description: Exactly one of 'exists' or 'notExists' naming a related entity, reached via 'path' (the relationship/lookup field), bounded by 'filter'. No other property is permitted on a clause -- this is what makes a 'bind' (variable-binding) property a schema-level refusal rather than a review-time catch.

exists.description: The related entity logical name that must exist for this clause to hold.

notExists.description: The related entity logical name that must NOT exist for this clause to hold.

path.description: The relationship/lookup field on the related entity pointing back to the subject.

filter.description: A clause's bounded Dataverse-filter-shaped bag of field -> value/operator constraints: the shared filterConditions grammar plus at least one condition. Filter values are ids, never labels (mvp-technical-spec.md section 3.4a).

filterConditions.description: The field -> value/operator grammar shared by every clause 'filter' and by the subject's 'when' scope (task 022 rework round 2, F7: 'when' previously accepted any object, so its values skipped the per-value rules below).

filterValue.description: A scalar, an array of scalars (e.g. an id list), or a single-operator comparison object. No variant admits a cross-clause variable reference.

scalar.description: A literal string, number or boolean. Strings MUST NOT begin with '$' -- that token is reserved for cross-clause variable dereferencing (e.g. '$commitment.sprk_receiveddate'), which this grammar does not support (design.md section 8.0.1(a)).
